### P1 "classic_pbr_full" (Render Pipeline) · Fragment

description: Full glTF metallic-roughness rasterizer for a Scene Preprocessor output: draws the whole scene in one indirect draw with every material texture (base colour, metal-rough, normal map with tangents, emissive, occlusion; texcoord sets, KHR_texture_transform, wrap modes, alpha MASK and BLEND, double-sided), the scene's lights (directional, point and spot, with range and falloff; procedural lights wri…; categories: 3D, Scene, MDI, Textured, Normal-Mapped; inputs: camera:uniform, scene_lights:storage, scene_light_indices:storage, world_transforms:storage, scene_materials:storage, scene_material_uv_xforms:storage, per_draws:storage, indirect_draw_cmds:storage, scene_counts:storage, env:uniform, alpha_a2c_enabled:long=0, volumetric_enabled:long=0, volumetric_intensity:float=1


### P7 "Depth Neon Outlines" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Neon/Tron-style glowing outlines. Runs Sobel on depth, then convolves the edge mask with a small radial kernel to produce a soft glow bleed, then composites glow + hard edge back over the scene. Single-pass, but expensive (8 extra 3x3 depth gathers per pixel). Glow and edges are painted over the input, so they also show over a transparent sky.; categories: Post-process, Outlines; inputs: inputImage:image, camera:uniform, edgeColor:color=[1,0.9,0.95,1], glowColor:color=[1,0.1,0.6,1], edgeThreshold:float=0.08, edgeSoftness:float=0.04, glowRadius:long=2, glowIntensity:float=1.5, dimScene:float=0.5

43 lines, not listed: the process was created from the library file `<LIBRARY>:packages/score-csf-testers/shaderlib/depth/Depth Neon Outlines.fs`.

### P8 "Depth Halftone" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Newspaper-halftone dots whose dot frequency scales with depth: near = fine print, far = big coarse dots. Dot radius within each cell is driven by local luminance so the image still reads. Classic print-shop feel. By default the output is an opaque print: transparent areas of the input print as bare paper.
